title: Frontend Developer
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a Frontend Developer to join our engineering team and build modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications. You will work closely with product managers, designers, backend developers, and QA engineers to create intuitive user experiences for digital banking, lending, and enterprise software solutions. Responsibilities Develop and maintain responsive web applications using modern frontend technologies Build reusable UI components and frontend modules Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement user-friendly interfaces Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsive design Optimize application performance and user experience Troubleshoot and resolve frontend issues and bugs Participate in code reviews and development discussions Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code Stay updated with emerging frontend technologies and best practices Requirements 1-3 years of experience in Frontend Development Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript Hands-on experience with ReactJS Good understanding of responsive web design principles Experience consuming REST APIs Familiarity with modern frontend development tools and workflows Knowledge of version control systems such as Git Understanding of UI/UX best practices Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Good communication and teamwork abilities Nice to have Experience with TypeScript Familiarity with Next.js Experience with Material UI, Ant Design, or similar component libraries Knowledge of Redux or Context API Understanding of frontend performance optimization techniques Exposure to fintech, banking, lending, or enterprise applications Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies For more info please refer to our privacy policy. 

Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
